scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontends && npm run setup:identity
scripts.setup:frontends: npm ci --prefix apps/cube && npm ci --prefix apps/cdex && npm ci --prefix apps/bils
scripts.lint:frontends: npm run lint --prefix apps/cube && npm run lint --prefix apps/cdex && npm run lint --prefix apps/bils
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontends && npm run lint:identity && npm run lint:go
scripts.build:frontends: npm run build --prefix apps/cube && npm run build --prefix apps/cdex && npm run build --prefix apps/bils
scripts.build: npm run build:frontends && npm run build:identity && npm run build:go
scripts.test:frontends: npm run build:frontends && npm run test --prefix apps/cube && npm run test --prefix apps/cdex && npm run test --prefix apps/bils
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:identity && npm run test:frontends
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: docker compose up --build --detach gateway && node scripts/smoke-compose.mjs
